items.title: Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon
items.summary: An augmented-reality industrial safety assistant: a self-driving rover that patrols warehouse space and inspects for hazards like misplaced pallets or blocked aisles.

architecture.detail: Runs optimized YOLO object detection on a low-latency video stream.
Physical safety interlock (piezo buzzers, LEDs, motor PWM).
Runs a Vision-Language Model for scene reasoning, producing safety reports on a central dashboard.
